design_recommendations.variant_warning: Neither clip contains a frame with both upper-arm/trunk angles >150 degrees. Signed bend buckets show one raised arm and one lowered arm. These clips support a one-arm variant preview, not calibration of the requested two-arms-overhead variant.
design_recommendations.safe_default: Unreviewed rules off, unknown phase and unverified view block feedback. Explicit exploratory opt-in and declared compatible variant are required for demo replay.

elbow_draft.scope: Only the arm declared raised by the current independently supplied phase/variant; both elbows for a separately verified two-arm variant.
elbow_draft.evidence: Supplied correct clip has no elbow below 150 degrees. Incorrect left elbow stays below 150 for 7265ms overall, including 1633ms in the <-15deg image-left bend bucket. Right elbow deviations are shorter and overlapping.
elbow_draft.limitations: Conservative engineering demo, not yoga instruction; 160deg recovery is a hysteresis design choice, not a percentile estimate; upper-arm selection must not be needed to make an elbow error assessable.

monitor_only: Torso side-bend amplitude and too-little/too-much bend: no reviewed target or hold windows; do not encourage deeper bend from these clips.
Upper-arm/trunk angle: correct bend phases have raised-arm median around139–144deg, so 165deg upright-overhead threshold causes false candidates.
Stance ratio: incorrect has >0.4 for11131ms early, but human stance vs camera/rotation/subject effect is unverified; shoulder denominator changes with side-bend.
Shoulder height difference is expected to increase in side-bend; never reuse the mountain leveling rule.
Hip centering/motion, head alignment, palms together, depressed shoulders, body coplanarity, and weight distribution cannot be established from the existing eight scalar features.
